_doc: Exercise config for the locked 3D set (t562u). Only motion + anatomy targets live here; mannequin/equipment/camera/materials come from studio3d/set_v1.json. Angles are 3D joint angles taken from configs/motion_standards.json -> exercises.incline_dumbbell_press.

wrong.why: mistakes.elbow_flare_90: arm_torso > 75 at max elbow flexion

right.why: right_form.elbow_tuck_bottom 45-60 at max elbow flexion; full_rom 80-110

notes: elbow_drop_deg = angle of the upper arm below (+) / above (-) the chest plane; at the top the arms point up over the shoulders.
